BANELING.name: Baneling
BANELING.description: Paid Zergling morph sacrificed for ground area damage, especially against suitable Light targets. Source Zergling cost is already invested and should not be purchased twice in reasoning. Contact and target density determine payoff; kiting or poor connections can waste the unit.

BROODLORD.name: Brood Lord
BROODLORD.description: Heavy aircraft morphed from Corruptor through Greater Spire. It attacks ground through Broodlings and needs protection against aircraft and closing threats. The morph consumes existing anti-air; it is neither a new Larva product nor a fast harassment flyer.

CORRUPTOR.name: Corruptor
CORRUPTOR.description: Durable anti-air flyer without an ordinary ground-unit weapon. Caustic Spray channels against structures rather than solving ground-army combat. Greater Spire permits a paid Brood Lord morph, exchanging anti-air investment for ground siege pressure.

DRONE.name: Drone
DRONE.description: Worker morphed from Larva for resources and construction. A standard building consumes its Drone, reducing workers and releasing supply. Worker growth competes with army/Overlord Larva, and new structures can require replacement workers.

HYDRALISK.name: Hydralisk
HYDRALISK.description: Ranged ground/air attacker with range and mobility upgrades. Broad target coverage does not protect it from splash, focused fire, or poor positioning. Lurker Den permits a paid morph, exchanging direct ground/air flexibility for stationary ground area control.

INFESTOR.name: Infestor
INFESTOR.description: Ground caster using Fungal Growth, researched Neural Parasite, and the applicable Shroud rules. It needs energy, protection, and an army able to exploit its effects. A control spell does not guarantee follow-up damage, and an exposed caster may die before contributing.

LARVA.name: Larva
LARVA.acquisition: Generated by Hatchery/Lair/Hive and Queen injects; not purchased as an ordinary unit.
LARVA.description: Production resource generated by Hatchery/Lair/Hive and Queen injects. It morphs into workers, supply units, and most army units according to tech. It is neither a collecting worker nor a tech building; every Overlord uses Larva otherwise available for workers or army.

LOCUSTMP.name: Locust
LOCUSTMP.acquisition: Spawned by Swarm Host; temporary wave rather than a Larva production order.
LOCUSTMP.description: Temporary Swarm Host attacker, not an independently purchased Larva product. Limited lifetime makes travel and landing position important. Removing the wave does not remove its host; withdrawing can deny much of a wave's useful duration.

LURKERMP.name: Lurker
LURKERMP.description: Paid Hydralisk morph unlocked by Lurker Den. It must enter its burrowed combat mode for line-splash ground fire. Unburrowed movement allows repositioning but supplies neither ordinary moving attacks nor anti-air.

LURKERMPBURROWED.name: Lurker (burrowed)
LURKERMPBURROWED.acquisition: Transform an existing unit or structure.
LURKERMPBURROWED.description: Concealed stationary ground area attacker with line splash. Detection reveals but does not disarm it. Approach angles and support shape the exchange. Hive-gated specialization improves control; aircraft and forced repositioning exploit its ground-only stationary role.

MUTALISK.name: Mutalisk
MUTALISK.description: Fast ground/air harassment flyer with bouncing attacks. It punishes exposed workers and reinforcements but risks poor exchanges into prepared splash anti-air. Mobility has value when it reaches useful targets and survives to threaten another position.

OVERLORD.name: Overlord
OVERLORD.description: Flying supply unit/scout without normal detection or a weapon. Losing it can block production. Lair enables detector/transport branches and creep uses. Deep scouting through anti-air risks both information and the supply supporting future production.

OVERSEER.name: Overseer
OVERSEER.acquisition: Overlord + Lair; or Transport Overlord + Lair.
OVERSEER.description: Lair-tier Overlord morph providing detection, Changeling scouting, and Contaminate. It has no normal weapon. Energy and survival constrain support, and creating one does not turn the rest of the Overlords into detectors.

OVERSEERSIEGEMODE.name: Overseer (Oversight Mode)
OVERSEERSIEGEMODE.acquisition: Transform an existing unit or structure.
OVERSEERSIEGEMODE.description: Stationary observation mode retaining detection with extended coverage. It must leave the mode to accompany moving forces. It is not another paid detector morph or independent source of supply.

QUEEN.name: Queen
QUEEN.acquisition: Hatchery + Spawning Pool; or Hive + Spawning Pool; or Lair + Spawning Pool.
QUEEN.description: Town-hall-produced support/defense unit whose production does not consume Larva. Inject, Creep Tumor, and Transfusion share energy. Ground/air weapons help early defense, but slow off-creep travel and base-support commitments limit its ability to follow every army.

RAVAGER.name: Ravager
RAVAGER.description: Roach morph with ground attack and Corrosive Bile. Bile adds delayed area pressure and Force Field removal, and can threaten aircraft despite the normal ground-only weapon. Effective spell placement matters; launched Bile is not a guaranteed hit.

ROACH.name: Roach
ROACH.description: Durable ranged ground unit unlocked by Roach Warren. It supplies early staying power and researched movement/burrow options but cannot attack air. A Ravager morph changes investment, supply, range, attributes, and composition rather than adding a separate unit alongside the Roach.

SWARMHOSTMP.name: Swarm Host
SWARMHOSTMP.description: Ground siege/harassment unit producing temporary Locust waves on a cooldown. Repeated waves need no new Larva per attacker, but hosts have little direct fighting value between waves. Escape routes, access, and enemy punishment during downtime determine effectiveness.

OVERLORDTRANSPORT.name: Transport Overlord
OVERLORDTRANSPORT.description: Paid transport morph retaining the Overlord supply role. It is distinct from the Overseer detector branch. Travel, cargo survival, unload space, and enemy anti-air constrain drops; a loss can cost passengers and supply together.

ULTRALISK.name: Ultralisk
ULTRALISK.description: Large melee ground unit with area damage and dedicated armor/movement research. It needs contact and room to exploit durability. Allied traffic, chokes, kiting, and concentrated anti-Armored fire undermine it. It has no anti-air and needs matching support.

VIPER.name: Viper
VIPER.description: Hive-tier air caster with Abduct, Blinding Cloud, Parasitic Bomb, and Consume. It changes engagement conditions without a normal weapon. Consume damages friendly structures to restore energy. Protected movement and eligible target selection are essential to using its spells.

ZERGLING.name: Zergling
ZERGLING.description: Fast melee ground unit produced in pairs from one Larva order. Metabolic Boost improves movement/surrounds; Adrenal Glands improves attack speed. It cannot hit aircraft and needs contact. Splash, narrow chokes, and blocked surrounds reduce the benefit of numbers.

BANELINGNEST.name: Baneling Nest
BANELINGNEST.description: Pool-dependent unlock for Zergling-to-Baneling morph and Lair-gated Centrifugal Hooks. It directly produces neither source Zerglings nor final Banelings; Larva spending and morph spending are separate steps.

CREEPTUMOR.name: Creep Tumor
CREEPTUMOR.acquisition: Queen placement or propagation from an eligible mature Creep Tumor.
CREEPTUMOR.description: Creep source placed by Queen or propagated from an eligible mature tumor. It supports map coverage and placement without a normal weapon. Buried state normally requires detection, and maturity/use rules prevent unlimited immediate propagation.

EVOLUTIONCHAMBER.name: Evolution Chamber
EVOLUTIONCHAMBER.description: Ground weapon/carapace researcher. Melee and missile tracks affect different weapon families, with armor separate. Higher levels need the relevant town-hall tier and previous level. It neither produces army nor replaces Pool for static-defense tech.

EXTRACTOR.name: Extractor
EXTRACTOR.description: Drone-built gas structure whose builder is consumed; other assigned Drones harvest. Raw API cost can include the worker and differ from the incremental order. It uses a geyser rather than requiring ordinary creep placement.

GREATERSPIRE.name: Greater Spire
GREATERSPIRE.description: Hive-enabled Spire morph retaining prior tech/research and unlocking Corruptor-to-Brood-Lord morph. It does not independently produce Brood Lords or replace the need for Corruptors. Full unit value includes the source Spire.

HATCHERY.name: Hatchery
HATCHERY.description: Town hall, collection point, creep/Larva source, and Queen producer after Pool. Additional Hatcheries increase potential Larva as well as expansion options; a macro Hatchery need not be at a new resource line. Lair is a paid morph of this structure.

HIVE.name: Hive
HIVE.description: Lair morph requiring Infestation Pit. It unlocks late units, tech, and research while retaining collection, creep, Larva, and Queen production. It upgrades an existing base rather than creating a fresh expansion or resource line.

HYDRALISKDEN.name: Hydralisk Den
HYDRALISKDEN.description: Lair-tier Hydralisk unlock, range/mobility researcher, and prerequisite for Lurker Den. Hydralisks come from Larva. Late Hydralisk ability research also needs Hive in the installed research table.

INFESTATIONPIT.name: Infestation Pit
INFESTATIONPIT.description: Lair-tier unlock for Infestor and Swarm Host, and prerequisite for Hive morph. It hosts Infestor research. Seeing the Pit is a technology signal, not proof that a particular unit branch was purchased.

LAIR.name: Lair
LAIR.description: Pool-unlocked Hatchery morph retaining town-hall roles and unlocking mid-tier structures, morphs, and research. Infestation Pit enables Hive. Full API unit value includes earlier Hatchery investment rather than representing only the Lair morph order.

LURKERDENMP.name: Lurker Den
LURKERDENMP.description: Hydralisk Den-dependent unlock for Hydralisk-to-Lurker morph. Basic Lurker access precedes its Hive-only specialization upgrades. The building cannot create Lurkers without source Hydralisks and does not provide anti-air itself.

NYDUSNETWORK.name: Nydus Network
NYDUSNETWORK.description: Lair-tier network creating Worm exits at legal visible locations. It moves eligible ground units rather than producing an army. Enemies can destroy a scouted exit before useful unloading, so placement and response timing matter.

NYDUSCANAL.name: Nydus Worm
NYDUSCANAL.description: Exit created through a Nydus Network rather than by a Drone. It must survive emergence and unloading to move the intended force. It is not an ordinary combat unit or guaranteed safe arrival point.

ROACHWARREN.name: Roach Warren
ROACHWARREN.description: Pool-dependent Roach unlock and Lair-gated mobility/burrow researcher. Ravagers morph from Roaches without a separate Ravager building. Losing the Warren does not delete existing Roaches.

SPAWNINGPOOL.name: Spawning Pool
SPAWNINGPOOL.description: Early tech unlocking Zerglings, Queens, static defenses, Roach Warren, Baneling Nest, and Lair. It researches Zergling speed and Hive-gated attack speed. Zerglings come from Larva and Queens from town-hall queues, not directly from the Pool.

SPINECRAWLER.name: Spine Crawler
SPINECRAWLER.description: Pool-unlocked creep-based ground defense. Uprooting permits repositioning but removes firing until it roots legally again. It has neither anti-air nor general detection, requiring complementary defense.

SPIRE.name: Spire
SPIRE.description: Lair-tier unlock for Larva-produced Mutalisk/Corruptor and air weapon/carapace research. Hive enables Greater Spire morph. The two ordinary products have different ground/air coverage despite sharing an unlock.

SPORECRAWLER.name: Spore Crawler
SPORECRAWLER.description: Pool-unlocked creep-based anti-air defense and detector. Uprooting trades active defense for movement. Detection does not add a ground weapon, and coverage must overlap the protected area to reveal threats.

ULTRALISKCAVERN.name: Ultralisk Cavern
ULTRALISKCAVERN.description: Hive-tier unlock for Larva-produced Ultralisks and their specialization research. This invests in ground melee rather than solving air or detection coverage. Production still requires resources, Larva, and supply.

BROODLING.name: Broodling
BROODLING.description: Temporary melee attacker associated with Brood Lord attacks and some structure-death effects. It adds ground contact damage and interference but is not an independently selected Larva product. Short lifetime makes creation position important.

CHANGELING.name: Changeling
CHANGELING.description: Temporary Overseer-created scout that can imitate enemy infantry appearance. It does not acquire a real Marine, Zealot, or Zergling's fighting value. A disguise is not evidence of ordinary infantry production.

LOCUSTMPFLYING.name: Flying Locust
LOCUSTMPFLYING.description: Airborne travel state of a temporary Swarm Host attacker. It needs the proper transition to use ground attacks. Travel consumes its limited lifetime, making arrival and useful damage separate outcomes.

EGGS_AND_COCOONS.name: Eggs and cocoons
EGGS_AND_COCOONS.description: EGG, BANELINGCOCOON, RAVAGERCOCOON, LURKERMPEGG, BROODLORDCOCOON, OVERLORDCOCOON, and transport-morph cocoons are in-progress production states. Do not count both an in-progress source/order and its future result as two completed assets. Killing production state can prevent the final unit from appearing.

UPROOTED_DEFENSES_AND_BURIED_TUMORS.name: Uprooted defenses and buried tumors
UPROOTED_DEFENSES_AND_BURIED_TUMORS.description: SPINECRAWLERUPROOTED and SPORECRAWLERUPROOTED move without their rooted fighting function. CREEPTUMORBURROWED is a concealed tumor state. Separate IDs represent lifecycle state rather than independent purchases.
